cues.en: In this video, we're going to talk about how to contribute to open source and actually take you through the steps.
cues.zh: 這支影片要談如何參與開放原始碼，並實際帶你完成步驟。

cues.en: But first, for those who don't know what is open source.
cues.zh: 先向還不熟悉的人解釋，什麼是開放原始碼。

cues.en: Well, a lot of technology that has been created on the Internet that we know today has been built on
cues.zh: 今天網際網路上許多我們熟悉的技術，都是建立在

cues.en: top of open source projects and open source projects means that anybody can view the code.
cues.zh: 開放原始碼專案之上。開放原始碼，表示任何人都能查看程式碼。

cues.en: Anybody can see the code of a program, can inspect it, can modify it, can enhance it.
cues.zh: 任何人都能看到程式的原始碼、檢查、修改，也能強化它。

cues.en: In this way, the idea is that by sharing this information with everybody, we get everybody's input and we use the collective mind to improve software.
cues.zh: 這個理念是，透過和所有人分享資訊，取得大家的意見，運用集體智慧改善軟體。

cues.en: Not only that, but it also benefits everybody, right?
cues.zh: 不僅如此，所有人也都受益，對吧？

cues.en: For example, the most famous example of an open source project is Linux, an operating system just
cues.zh: 例如，最有名的開放原始碼專案之一是 Linux，這是一套作業系統，

cues.en: like Windows or Mac OS, except it's built by everyday programmers.
cues.zh: 就像 Windows 或 macOS，只是由一般程式設計師共同打造。

cues.en: And it's code that is completely open sourced.
cues.zh: 它的程式碼完全開放。

cues.en: Anybody can inspect the code, add on to it.
cues.zh: 任何人都能檢查程式碼、擴充功能。

cues.en: And it's become so successful that most of the cloud that we know of the servers usually run Linux,
cues.zh: 它非常成功，我們熟悉的多數雲端伺服器通常都執行 Linux。

cues.en: AWS, Google Cloud, Microsoft Azure, all of them use Linux.
cues.zh: AWS、Google Cloud、Microsoft Azure，全都使用 Linux。

cues.en: Some of you might be running Linux right now as you watch this video.
cues.zh: 你們有些人，現在可能就是在 Linux 上看這支影片。

cues.en: So not only do you get to work with other developers from around the world where you can build great projects, but just working in teams by learning how open source works.
cues.zh: 所以，不只可以和全球開發人員一起打造很棒的專案，也能透過了解開源運作方式，練習團隊合作。

cues.en: Well, you don't have to create something as big as Linux.
cues.zh: 你不必打造像 Linux 這麼大的東西。

cues.en: You can create a project with a friend.
cues.zh: 可以和朋友一起建立專案。

cues.en: Something very small and simple.
cues.zh: 很小、很簡單也可以。

cues.en: It doesn't really matter.
cues.zh: 那並不重要。

cues.en: The idea is of collaboration, of openness and sharing code to hopefully improve on the collective knowledge.
cues.zh: 重點是協作、開放與分享程式碼，希望能提升集體知識。

cues.en: Finally, a lot of employers actually look upon open source contribution as a plus.
cues.zh: 最後，很多雇主也會把開源貢獻視為加分項目。

cues.en: So if you're able to put in your resume that you're an open source contributor, well, that's a good sign.
cues.zh: 所以，如果履歷能寫自己是開源貢獻者，那是個好訊號。

cues.en: Plus, it teaches you valuable skills using Git and GitHub to work in teams.
cues.zh: 此外，也能學到用 Git 和 GitHub 團隊合作的寶貴技能。

cues.en: If you're looking for job experience but you don't have a job, contributing to open source is the perfect way for you to learn how to work in teams and mimic a work like scenario.
cues.zh: 如果想累積工作經驗，卻還沒工作，參與開源是學習團隊合作、模擬工作情境的好方法。

cues.en: This is a really important video and something I'm really excited about.
cues.zh: 這支影片很重要，我也非常期待。

cues.en: So let's show you how to make your first open source contribution improve your resume.
cues.zh: 來看看怎麼做出第一次開源貢獻、改善履歷，

cues.en: Learn some real life skills and have fun along the way.
cues.zh: 學習實務技能，同時享受過程。

cues.en: Now, we've actually created some open source projects for you for this course.
cues.zh: 我們其實已經為這門課準備了一些開源專案。

cues.en: You can contribute at silly things, whatever you want.
cues.zh: 可以貢獻一些好玩的小東西，做自己想做的事。

cues.en: It's a testing ground.
cues.zh: 這是個試驗場。

cues.en: The idea is to have as much fun as possible and make it as easy as possible to contribute to open source.
cues.zh: 目標是盡量讓大家玩得開心，並讓參與開源變得越容易越好。

cues.en: Now, within that organization, we have a great community of administrator or management team that will help you with these open source projects.
cues.zh: 這個組織裡，有很棒的管理團隊社群，協助你參與這些開源專案。

cues.en: They're right here.

cues.en: Ignore my name.

cues.en: I help out as well.

cues.en: But they do a lot of the heavy lifting and they are past students just like you that have had a bit of experience.
cues.zh: 但主要的繁重工作是他們在做。他們以前也和你一樣是學員，現在已有一些經驗。

cues.en: Now most of them are working full time, but they are now helping out the community by helping with
cues.zh: 多數人現在都有全職工作，但仍會回來幫助社群，協助

cues.en: our open source projects, our discord, and generally just helping our community grow.
cues.zh: 開源專案、Discord，以及整體社群成長。

cues.en: So shout out to them if you get a chance, say hi to them.
cues.zh: 所以有機會的話，向他們致意、打個招呼。

cues.en: On Discord.
cues.zh: 可以在 Discord 上。

cues.en: They definitely do a lot for this community.
cues.zh: 他們真的為社群做了很多事。

cues.en: They're very active on discord and they really help maintain all of our open source projects.
cues.zh: 他們在 Discord 非常活躍，也協助維護所有開源專案。

cues.en: So let's learn how to make our very first open source contribution.
cues.zh: 接著學習第一次開源貢獻。

cues.en: I do want to note here that this isn't the only way for you to contribute to open source.
cues.zh: 先提醒，這不是參與開源的唯一方式。

cues.en: But once you contribute here, you can go off and contribute to all the other open source projects all over GitHub that you can find.
cues.zh: 在這裡貢獻之後，就可以去參與 GitHub 上找到的其他各種開源專案。

cues.en: You can contribute to projects like React and Angular.
cues.zh: 例如 React、Angular。

cues.en: The world is your oyster, or you can just stick to these as we actually have a ton of projects here that are fun.
cues.zh: 選擇非常多；或者就留在這裡，也可以，因為我們有很多有趣的專案。

cues.en: Well, we'll get to that shortly.
cues.zh: 稍後會談到。

cues.zh: 不然，希望你已經熟悉 Git 和 GitHub。

cues.zh: 但一般參與開源時，更推薦先 fork 專案。

cues.en: Fork essentially means copy over the entire project and put it on your own GitHub profile.
cues.zh: fork 基本上就是把整個專案複製到自己的 GitHub 帳號底下。

cues.en: So if I click Fork here and we see over here that you can select where you want to fork the project and you want to select your profile.
cues.zh: 按這裡的 Fork，可以選擇要放到哪裡，選自己的個人帳號。

cues.en: So once we fork this project, we make a copy of it.
cues.zh: fork 後，就有一份專案副本。

cues.en: It's like we own this repository now with our own version of the start here guidelines.
cues.zh: 像是自己擁有了這個儲存庫，有自己版本的 start-here-guidelines。

cues.zh: 我用 SSH，這樣就不用每次輸入密碼。

cues.en: I can now say git, clone and clone this repository.

cues.en: Now, here's the thing.
cues.zh: 不過，要注意。

cues.zh: 我們有 fork 的專案，應該新建分支，在新分支工作，而非 master。執行 git checkout，接上

cues.zh: 再替分支命名。

cues.zh: 這裡使用 Markdown，一種撰寫文字、提供一些格式功能的語法。

cues.zh: list。

cues.zh: 意思就是推送到 origin，而這個 origin
